content: Isare marifelaibolla felain goijje
Uddar id edde iš adiya ruṭir id aite šude dui din baki. Ḍõr imam edde alem okkole gufone Isare dori marifelaibolla ufai tuwail.
Hitara hodde, "Idor šomot no, manuš okkolor butore gulmal uṛit fare"
Betaniyat Isare dami kušbo tel ḍali diye

Isa Betaniyar kurus biyaraimma Šimonor górot aiššil. Hitara hána hadde šomot ekzon mayafuwaye ek dóla fattoror boyomot gori kub beši dami edde asoli kušbo tel loi hibar hãse aišše. Hibaye boyommuwa bainge edde telgunore Isar matat ḍali diye.
Heṛe zara hazir aššil, hitarar butottu ho ekzone naraz oiyore hodde, "Ei dami zinišgun kiyolla borbat gorifela or?
Ei tel to beši dame besa zaito edde ṭiyagun loi gorib okkolore modotolla diya zaito." Ar hitara mayafuwaware hora bafe zejeṛaiye.
Hetunot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara hibare loi hen kiyolla goror? Hibaye ãlla ekkan bala ham goijje.
Gorib okkol to hamiša tũwarar fũwati ase, ar zẽtte mone ho tũwara hitarare modot gori fariba, kintu ãre tũwara hamiša no faiba.
Hibaye ziyan gori faitto hiyan goijje, hibaye ãr uwore ei kušbo tel ḍali diyore agottu loti ãre hoborolla tiyar goijje.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, duniyair ze hono mikka zeṛe kušir hóbor tobolig gora oibo, heṛe ei mayafuwaware monot goribolla hibar ei hamor hota o howa oibo."

content: Ehudah Iskariyote Isare tuli dibolla razi oiye
Tarfore Ehudah Iskariyot, he baro zonor butoror ekzon, hite ḍõr imamor hãse giye edde hitarar hatot Isare tuli di faribo hoiye.
Hitara hendilla funiyore beši kuši oiye edde hitare ṭĩya dibo hoi wada diye. He oite hite hibare hitarar hatot kene tulidi faribo he šuzug tuwa šuru goijje.
Sahabi okkol loi Isar šeš hána

Iš adiya ruṭir idor foila dinot din, zẽtte rosom mozin uddar idor hánalla soolor so zorgora oito, sahabi okkole hibattu fusar goijje, "Malik, ãra hoṛe zai õnolla uddar idor hána tiyar goriyum so, zene õne uddar id falon gori faro?"
Toi hibaye hibar sahabi okkolor dui zonore endilla hoi defeṛaiye,

content.text: "Tũwara šohoror butore zo! Heṛe ekzon manuše ek góra fani boi loi zadde lot faiba. Tũwara hitar fise fise zaiba.
Ar heṛe hite ze górot golibo, tũwara he góror girosore hoiba, 'Ustade fusar goijje, gorba gór hoṛe, zeṛe ãi ãr šahabi okkolore loi uddar idor hána hái fari?'
Henot hite tũwarare tiyar goijja dui ṭalar uwore ekkan ḍõr rum dehai dibo. Heṛe zai ãralla tiyar gorogoi."

content: Toi sahabi okkole baisa diye edde šohoror butore giye. Ar Isaye zendilla hoil he mozin hin hitara faiye edde uddar idor hána tiyar goijje.
Bade hazinna zehon oiye, Isaye he barozon sahabire loi heṛe aišše.
Hitara hánar hádde šomot hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, tũwarar butottu ekzone ze ãr fũwati hána hár, hite ãre dušmonor hatot tuli dibo."

content: Toi hitara ferešan oiye edde ekzon bade ekzone hibattu fusar goijje, "Hiba ki ãi?"
Hibaye zuwab diye,

content.text: "Ze ãr fũwati hoddat ruṭi burar, hite.
Kiyollahoile Adomor Futor morar babute zendilla leka ase, hendilla oibo. Kintu afsus he manušwalla, Adomor Fut loi ze beimani gorer! Hite honodin zormo no owa iyan hitalla aro beši bala oito."

content: Malikor hána
Hitara hána hadde šomot hibaye ruṭi loi šukuriya zanaiye edde hibaye ruṭiware bainge, toi sahabi okkolore diyore hodde,

content.text: "In lo, hó, in ãr ga."

content: Tarfore hibaye fiyala loiyore šukuriya zanaiye, hitarare diye edde hitara beggune hibattu fi háiye.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "In ãr lou, noya wadar suktir lou, zin beši mainšolla ḍali diya oibo.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ãngur gasor šoraf ãi ar honodin no fiyum, zeto din Allar raijjot abar noya gori hin no fiyi."

content: Tarfore hitara tarifor gan gaye, toi niyoli Zaitun faharot giye.
Isaye Fitoror ošikaror babute hor
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara beggune fori zaibagoi edde ãre eri zaibagoi," Kiyollahoile iyan endilla leka ase:
"'Ãi sool soroyare marifelaiyum,
ar soolgun sairo mikka šiṛašitta oi zaiboi'
Kintu ãi uṛizaigoi bade, ãi tũwarar age Galilot zaiyum."

content: Hetunot Fitore hodde: "Zodi õnore beggune felai zailegoi o, ãi hen no goijjum."
Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tore soiyi hoir, ehon aijja raitor butore, rata kuraye dui bar bak no dite, tui ãre tin bar ošikar goribi."

content: Kintu Fitore aro zur diyore hodde, "Zodi ãttu õnor fũwati mora o fore, to ãi õnore ošikar no goriyum!" He ekkui hota hitara beggune hoiye.
Isa Mosi Getsemoni baganot
Ar hitara Getsemoni name ek zagat aišše, toi hibaye sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zetun duwa gori, tũwara eṛe boiyo."

content: Tarfore hibaye Fitor, Yakub edde Yuhannare fũwati loigiye edde monot kub beši zontrona edde hošto fa šuru goijje.
Ar hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Dukke ãr foran niyoli zargoi. Tũwara eṛe tako edde seton taikko."

content: Bade hiba hoddur dure zaiyore meṛit uite foijje edde munazat goijje zene šombob oile ei dukkor ṭaim hibar hãsottu dur oi zagoi.
Hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Abba, Baf! Tũwalla hár kissu šombob. Ãttu ei motor fiyalawa loifelo. Tarfore o ãr issaye no, šude tũwar issaye gora ok."

content: Tarfore hiba sahabi okkolor hãse uwafes firi aiyore hitarare gumot lot faiye. Hibaye Fitorore hodde,

content.text: "Simon, tui gum zodde neki? Ek gonḍa o ki seton tai no farili ne?
Seton tako ar duwa goro zene forikkat no foro! Dile issa gorer, kintu tũwarar ga durbol."

content: Abar hibaye zaiyore he ekkui munazat goijje.
Hiba abar firi ai hitarare gumot foijja faiye, kiyollahoile hitarar sukot gum bári aššil. Ar hitara hibare ki zuwab dibo buzi no faijjil.
Tisera bar hiba hitarar hãse firi aišše edde hodde,

content.text: "Ehono tũwara gum zor edde aram goror? Beši oiye! Šomoi hãse aišše. Adomor Futore gunagaror hatot tuli diya or.
Uṛo, solo, ãra zai! Ze ãre loi beimani gorer hite hãse aigiyegoi."

content: Isare doitto aišše

Ar hehon, hibaye ehon o hota hor, hen šomot Ehudah, ze barozon sahabir ekzon, hite heṛe aišše. Hitar fũwati ek ḍõr dole suri edde laṛi loi aišše. Hitarare defeṛaiyede oilde ḍõr imam okkol, alem okkol edde manuš okkolor murubbi okkole.
Beimani goroyaye hitara loi ekkan sinno ṭik goijjil: "Ãi zare suma diyum hite oilde hiba. Tũwara hitare doriba edde fahara diyore loi zaiba."
Ar hite aišše edde toratori Isar hãse zai hodde, "Rabbi" en hoi hite hibare suma diye.
Toi hitara hibare doijje.
Heṛe tiyai aiššilde hitarar butottu ekzone hitar suri niyolaiye edde ḍõr imamor gulamore hamela goijje edde hitar han haṛi loi felaiye.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ḍahait doitto zafan gori tũwara ãre kiyolla laṛi edde súri loi doitto aiššo? Ãi ki ḍahait?
Fotti din ãi tũwarar fũwati aššilam edde dórmogóror uṛanot šikka diyi, kintu hẽtte to tũwara ãre no doro! Kintu kitabor hota endilla gori furon owa forer."

content: Hetunot sahabi okkol beggune Isare eri dáigiyegoi.
Ekzon zuwan fuwaye šude ekkan saddor findiyore Isar fise fise gil. Hitara hitare doijje,
kintu hite he saddor felaiyore lenḍa dai giyegoi.
Ḍõr šobar sarme Isa Mosi
Hitara Isare ḍõr imamor hãse loigiye edde hár ḍõr imam okkol, he bura murobbi edde alem okkol beggune ekku fũwati dola oiye.
Kintu Fitore dure takiyore hibar fise fise zaite zaite, ḍõr imamor uṛanot foijjonto góille. Fitore heṛe faharadar okkolor fũwati oinor ṭalor ḍake boiyore oin fuhar.
Toi ḍõr imam okkol, bura murubbi okkol edde alem okkol, mani beggune Isare marifelaibolla hibar berudde goba zuhar goitto sail, kintu hitara honokiyore no fa.
Hibar berudde bout kiye misa goba diye, kintu hitarar goba no mile.
Hetunot ho ekzone uṛi tiyaye edde hibar berudde misa goba diye,
"Ãra hite endilla hodde fuinni, 'Ãi ei hate banaiya dórmogór bangifelaiyum edde tin dinor butore en ar ekkan tiyar goijjum, ziyan manušor hate banaiya no.'"
Kintu hitarar goba o no mile.
Hetunot ḍõr imame beggunor sarme tiyaiye edde Isare hodde, "Tor berudde hitara nališ goredde hinot tottu kissu hoibar nai neki?"
Kintu Isaye suf oi roiye edde hono zuwab no de. Ḍõr imame hibare abar fusar goijje, "Tui ki he rahamoti Allar Fut, Mosi?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi oi. Tũwara Adomor Futore he Šorbo Šoktiwalar ḍen ḍakottu boiṛade edde asmanor miyulat gori aiyedde dekiba."

content: Henot ḍõr imame hitar nizor hor faṛifelaiye edde hodde, "Ar ãrattu gobar ki dorhar?
Tũwara to kuferigan fuinno. Tũwara ki bafo?" Hitara beggune hibare duši goriyore moribar laikka hoi faisala diye.
Toi ho ekzone hibar gat sef maijje edde hibar muk bandi guša maijje edde hodde, "Tui nobi no ne? Sai, hosai tore hone maijje!" Ar faharadar okkole loizaiyore beši mara maijje.
Fitoror ošikar
Fitor zẽtte lamat uṛanot aššil, hetunot ḍõr imamor ekzon bandi heṛe aišše.
Hibar nozor Fitore oin fuhadde hikka foijje edde hibaye bala gori Fitoror mikka saiyore hodde, "Tui o to oi Nasarator Isar fũwati aššili."
Kintu Fitore hiyan ošikar goijje. "Tui kiyor babute hor hin ãi no zani, no buzir," endilla hoi Fitor baror dorozar hãse giye, ar hetunot ugguwa rata kuraye bak di uiṭṭe.
Kintu mayafuwaye Fitorore heṛe dekiyore abar heṛe zara tiyai aššil hitarare hodde, "Ite o hitarar ekzon."
Kintu Fitore abar hiyan o ošikar goijje. Aro hotun bade, zara heṛe tiyat aššil hitara o Fitorore hodde, "Hameka tui o utarar ekzon, kiyollahoile tui o to Galilor manuš, tor baša loi buza zar."
Kintu Fitore nizore bodduwa diyore hosom hái hodde, "Tũwara zar babute hota hor ãi he manušware no sini."
Ar hehon dusora bar rata kuraye bak diye. Toi Isaye Fitorore ki hoil hiyan hibattu monot foijje:

content.text: "Rata kuraye dui bar bak no dite tui ãre tin bar ošikar goribi."

content: Toi hiba handa šuru goijje.
